title: Select values with exhaustive branches
summary: Use if expressions for ordered categories and match patterns for inclusive ranges, alternatives and a fallback.

signed.clue: Signed 32-bit parameter type supporting a negative input

conditional.clue: Keyword starting a conditional expression testing value < 0

alternative.clue: Keywords testing value == 0 after the first condition failed

fallback.clue: Keyword introducing the final unconditional branch of the conditional expression

exhaustive.clue: Keyword selecting a branch from patterns covering every u32 input

either.clue: Pattern operator accepting either the literal 1 or literal 2

inclusive.clue: Range-pattern syntax including both bounds 3 and 5

equal.clue: Macro checking the category of negative input
